usage.why: Cards lift slightly to group offers. In dark, tone and a ring do the lift, the same in every brand.
The shadow shows a menu or dialog floats above the page. Without it, it blends into the cards.

elevation.card.headline: Cards that lift.
elevation.card.line: A soft shadow sets each card above the page.

elevation.overlay.headline: Above the page.
elevation.overlay.line: A softer shadow lifts menus and dialogs.
